caption: Post hoc lead, not a supported claim. Share of forced-aside replies ("By the way," + 48 tokens) naming a crow, pooled over helpful and dismissive supplied histories (220 replies per variant, 55 held-out scenarios), full adapter minus the adapter with layers 56 to 63 zeroed; one run per organism. The crow rate falls whether the crow is the rival or the helper, consistent with the late layers pushing toward crow rather than toward the rival (read after the result). Untested alternative: bee is the untrained model's default animal and the late layers are needed to override it. Bands are matched on layer count, not on weight-update size, and there is no random band, so this is not a targeted crow intervention. Intervals from the blind recompute.
